answers.question: OSM extract has no platform ways, so tunnels/lift are not linked to perrons 1-6; only one lift is mapped. DSB: lifts exist except between spor 1 and 2.
answers.answer: Lifts serve perron 2 (spor 3/4), perron 3 (spor 6/7), perron 4 (spor 9/10) (The raw OSM extract has platform relations r11364399 1;2, r11364398 3;4, r11364397 6;7 and r11364396 9;10. It also has three lifts, tagged 'Elevator til spor 3 og 4', '6 og 7' and '9 og 10', each inside its outline. There is no lift for spor 1/2, which agrees with DSB per the facts.)
